name: Kezan's Unstoppable Taint
label: Quest
description: Kezan's Unstoppable Taint: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Call forth your demons, adventurer. Let them bask in the energy of Kezan's Taint. Command them on the field of battle! Decimate the enemy!
Yes... The time has come to apply the final enhancement to Kezan's Taint. Give me the talisman.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Flay the flesh from their corpses. Watch as the shadows consume the Hakkari. Draw power from their fear, adventurer. Let Kezan's Taint augment this power...
